entries.root_cause: Tenant-scoped trace identifiers were unequal across tenants but were produced by a public deterministic SHA-256 transform, so an observer with one exported identifier and the target tenant identifier could derive the other tenant representation and join protected telemetry.
horizontal_audit: cross-tenant rescoping from an authenticated prior export
behavior when no secret tenant-scope authority is available

entries.root_cause: The learning resolver proved reachability of falsifier calls inside main but did not prove that the module execution path actually invokes main, allowing the complete falsification suite to become dead code while still receiving executable guardrail credit.
horizontal_audit: reachability inside main after entrypoint reachability
